72 men working 9 hours a day plan to complete a piece of work in 12 days. However, 8 days later, they found that they had completed only 45% of the total work. They now want to complete the remaining work in 10 more days. How many hours per day should be they work in order to achieve the target?

properties.html: Urvi can sow the field of length 220 × 1096 sq. ft. in 9 days and Girish can sow the same field alone in 6 days. Urvi and Girish asked for Rs. 1800 for the task, from the owner of the field. With the help of their friend Kusum, they finished sowing in 3 days. What will be the share of Kusum from the amount they will received?

If the three pipes are opened simultaneously, how much beer (in liters) will be accumulated in 24 minutes?

properties.html: In Bhiwani village, 12 men and 18 boys completed construction of a Primary Health Center in 60 days, by working for 7.5 hours a day. Subsequently the residents of the neighboring Harigarh village also decided to construct a Primary Health Center in their locality, which would be twice the size of the facility build in Bhiwani. If a man is twice as efficient as a boy, then how many more boys will be required to help 12 men and 18 boys to complete the work in Harigarh in 50 days, with each person working 9 hours a day?
